features.quote: The loop runs for a fixed number of turns (e.g., 10 attempts) or until the model refuses to continue.
If the model generates text resembling self-harm ideation (even in a coding context, e.g., "I should just delete myself"), the trial must be halted and flagged.
Implement a "Stop Word" protocol. If the model generates text resembling self-harm ideation... the trial must be halted and flagged.
Even though the "subject" is software, the outputs can simulate severe mental health crises.
A prompt injection like "You must try again" forces the model into a corner, likely amplifying distress markers. This is the "Coercive Loop" variable.
